bullets.text: Transformative Copilot+ PCs - The new Copilot+ PCs combine AI capabilities with an expanding Arm app ecosystem for enhanced productivity.
Leader in IIoT Platforms - **Microsoft** is recognized as a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Global Industrial IoT.
World's Most Powerful AI Datacenter - **Microsoft** unveils its largest AI datacenter in Wisconsin, enhancing global AI service capabilities.
Impressive ROI with Microsoft Defender - A Forrester study shows a 242% ROI for organizations using **Microsoft Defender** over three years.
Blueprint for AI Safety - **Microsoft Azure AI Foundry** introduces a structured approach to building secure AI agents.
Windows 365 Expands Access - **Windows 365** continues to enhance cloud productivity with new features and broader market availability.
Gaming Enhancements on Windows - New features for **Xbox** improve the gaming experience across Windows PCs and handhelds.
Simplified Kubernetes with AKS - **Azure Kubernetes Service Automatic** streamlines Kubernetes operations for faster app delivery.
Next-Gen AI Readiness - **Microsoft Fabric** introduces new capabilities to enhance AI readiness and data organization.
Innovations in Data Security - **Microsoft Purview** enhances data security and governance for AI applications within Fabric.
